name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign
summary: Russian hybrid and kinetic operations persist, highlighted by massive missile and drone strikes hitting Ukrainian civilian and energy infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv, ongoing airspace incursions along NATO's eastern flank, and coordinated sabotage risks.

name: North Korean Agentic AI Cyber Espionage Operations
summary: North Korean state-sponsored threat groups deploy sophisticated cryptocurrency theft and laundering frameworks, with the FBI formally attributing the record $6.3B Binance intrusion to TraderTraitor.

name: Ukrainian Strategic Counter-Refinery Deep Strike Wave
summary: Ukrainian deep-strike operations targeting Russian energy and defense industrial base infrastructure, highlighted by fresh drone strikes on the Slavneft-YANOS refinery in Yaroslavl.

name: Storm-1516 / Matryoshka US Election Influence Cluster
summary: Russian state-sponsored influence networks deploy generative AI, cloned media domains, and synthetic deepfake videos to manipulate political narratives and target candidates supporting Ukraine ahead of the US midterms.

name: Vapor Panda ARTEX Agentic Campaign
summary: Chinese state-sponsored APT Vapor Panda utilizes the AI-powered ARTEX penetration testing framework integrated with DeepSeek to compromise over 200 sensitive government and critical infrastructure targets globally at machine speed.

name: Volt Typhoon Silent Train Network
summary: Chinese state-sponsored espionage cluster utilizing disposable, multi-hop SOHO/IoT proxy chains to breach critical infrastructure and exploit network management and SD-WAN orchestrator appliances.

name: Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Threat actors are actively chaining multiple zero-day vulnerabilities in Ivanti Connect Secure, including CVE-2026-111357, to achieve unauthenticated root execution and bypass enterprise perimeter boundaries.

name: VOLTA Infostealer LLM-Powered Doxing Wave
summary: Malware campaign deploying the VOLTA-AUTODOXER implant, which utilizes multi-model LLM chains via OpenRouter to prioritize victim assets and OPSEC posture for automated extortion and triage.

name: AdFection Mercenary Spyware Campaign
summary: Mercenary spyware actors exploiting CoreGraphics vulnerabilities to target journalists, dissidents, and civil society actors.

name: PEERSTITCH Fortinet Edge Exploitation Wave
summary: Threat actors exploited FortiManager vulnerabilities to exfiltrate configs, deploying stealth in-memory malware PEERSTITCH.

name: Armory Castle Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Chinese state-sponsored espionage group Armory Castle weaponizes BeyondTrust Remote Support zero-day vulnerabilities.

name: PHP2Shell Global Remote Code Execution Wave
summary: Global exploitation of PHP multipart/form-data heap corruption; threat actors chaining PHP2Shell to attack perimeter firewalls and enterprise web services.

name: SafePay Double-Extortion Campaign
summary: Ransomware operation targeting critical infrastructure globally; joint advisories confirm compromises across hundreds of organizations.

name: GhostAction CI/CD Credential Exfiltration Wave
summary: Supply chain compromise spanning GitHub repositories, using malicious workflows to deliver infostealers and siphon cloud credentials.

name: APT28 European Defense Espionage Campaign
summary: Russian GRU (APT28) executing targeted intrusions against NATO naval shipbuilders and military aircraft engine manufacturers.
